name: motherlink-engage-rules-tests
description: Firestore security-rules tests (emulator) and server-logic unit tests (plain node).
comment:scripts: test:rules is now scoped to rules.test.mjs rather than a bare `node --test`. The bare form would also sweep up unit/*.test.mjs, which needs --experimental-strip-types and the loader in unit/register.mjs to import TypeScript from apps/web — and would fail without them, inside the emulator, for reasons that have nothing to do with rules.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.local/jdk/Contents/Home PATH=$HOME/.local/jdk/Contents/Home/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project motherlink-engage-test "node --test rules.test.mjs"
